_comment: Release notes shown in Settings > Version (TEN-193). Add the new release here at each tag, the same text as the GitHub release (see docs/ci.md, Release signée sur tag). Order does not matter, the app sorts by version.

releases.title: Permissions + Network
releases.intro: The model can now read your calendar and your approximate location, and, if you turn it on, look things up on the web. The Internet tier is off by default: with it off, nothing leaves the phone.

groups.label: Web (Settings > Tools > Internet, off by default)
items: Web search: DuckDuckGo, with Wikipedia and Marginalia as fallbacks, no key needed. Optional Tavily key (1,000 free searches a month, no card) or Brave key (monthly free credit, card required) in Settings, with a Test button
Read a web page: the model fetches a link and reads its text. HTTPS only, local and private addresses are blocked
Weather from Open-Meteo: today, tomorrow, a weekday or a date, for a city or "here"
Wikipedia summaries
Every network call shows where it went and what was sent: "Sent to DuckDuckGo · <query>"

groups.label: Phone, with Android permission at first use
items: Calendar: "what is on my calendar today?", a day or a range up to 31 days. Only titles, times and places reach the model
Location: approximate only (about 1 km), never precise GPS. tensai does not turn it into an address
Revoking a permission while the model uses it gives a clear refusal with a link to the app settings

groups.label: App
items: What's new: tap the version in Settings
Settings > Storage shows the real free space, with a colored legend (models, other data, free)

releases.title: Tooling
releases.intro: The model can now use tools: it checks things on the phone, acts through your apps, remembers what you tell it, and asks when your request is ambiguous. Everything still runs on the phone.

groups.label: Tools
items: On this phone: date and time, calculator, unit and time zone conversion, device info (battery, storage, RAM), search past chats, memory, clipboard, torch

Phone actions through your apps: timer, alarm, calendar event, SMS and email drafts (to a number or a contact name), open an app or a link, media control. Nothing is sent by tensai: the target app opens and you confirm there
Contacts: drafts accept a name ("Jade"); with several matches the model asks you which one. Android's contacts permission is asked at first use
Questions: the model can ask a single or multiple choice question; the card replaces the input bar
Memory: facts you ask it to remember are added to every conversation; manage or turn them off in Settings > Memory

groups.label: In the chat
items: Tool calls show as a discreet line between the reasoning and the answer; tap it for the timeline and each call's inputs and output
Calls that delete something or open a link ask first (Allow / Deny)
Settings > Tools: turn each tier on or off
Context sheet: tool definitions, tool results and memory in the breakdown, and an Agent activity section (calls, tokens, time per tool)
Copy a message: long press, or the copy button under replies

groups.label: Faster
items: The fixed part of the prompt (system and tool definitions) is cached on disk: the first tool turn after loading a model went from ~4 min to ~10 s
CPU models no longer send the prefill to the GPU: prompt processing ~4x faster, generation ~1.7x faster on a Dimensity 900
The UI no longer stutters while a prompt is processed
The reasoning of the current turn is kept between a tool call and its result, so the model continues instead of starting over

releases.title: Models
releases.intro: Models from Hugging Face, a context view, and a simpler navigation.

groups.label: Models
items: Discover: search Hugging Face, filters (fits my phone, tools), models recommended for your device
Repo page with every quant, its size and whether it fits; download with pause/resume, sha256 check, progress notification, mobile data and free space checks
Gated models with a Hugging Face token
Model picker from the chip in the input bar
Chat template fallback for GGUFs that ship without one
Files this build can't run (unknown architecture, draft heads) are flagged and can't be loaded
Per-architecture backend choice extended (lfm2 on CPU, nemotron_h on Vulkan)

groups.label: Chat
items: Context ring in the top bar and a Context sheet: token breakdown, runtime details
The app opens on a new chat; the old Home screen is its empty state
Chats page: search, grouped by date, multi-select delete
Input bar capped at 10 lines, scrolling past it

groups.label: Navigation
items: One conversation at the root; Models, Settings and Chats open on top and back returns to it
Drawer scrolls as one list, recents capped at 20 with "All chats"

releases.intro: First release: run a GGUF model fully on your phone and chat with it. Nothing leaves the device.

groups.label: Models
items: Import a GGUF file from this phone
llama.cpp engine on CPU and Vulkan, backend picked per architecture
Session cache: a conversation you reopen resumes without re-reading its history

groups.label: Chat
items: Markdown replies with code blocks, and the model's reasoning in a collapsible block
Per-conversation settings: instructions, thinking on or off, sampling presets, max response length
Onboarding on first launch, Home screen, empty and error states

groups.label: App
items: Settings: theme, language (English and French), backend, context length, KV cache type
Signed release APK built by CI
